title: rosa canina var. spuria
intro: Rosa canina var. spuria, commonly known as Wild Rose, is a variety of the Rosa canina plant, native to Europe and Western Asia. It is a shrub that has been traditionally used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, with known health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce inflammation, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina var. spuria include anti-edematous, anti-inflammatory, and anti-hemorrhagic properties, which can help to reduce swelling, ease pain, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, particularly beta-sitosterol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
